purpose: Teach: ディスカウント/映し出さ/敬遠/すみやか/追随/係員/きめる/くらべ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学費ディスカウント制度も検討してやろう
lines.en: Ren, I'll look into a tuition discount programme for you.
lines.style: Measured, assured. Leans forward slightly on the name. The tone of someone offering something concrete. Even pace, no rush — this is a decision already made.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究成果がスクリーンに映し出される機会も活かします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make use of every opportunity to present my research findings.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Quiet determination underneath. Steady pace, each word deliberate. The slight formality of someone taking a mentor seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、難解な分野を敬遠するな
lines.en: Ren, don't shy away from difficult fields.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Slight weight on the negative. The tone of someone correcting a pattern they've noticed. Clear eye contact in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。すみやかに対応致します
lines.style: Quick, clipped affirmation. No embellishment. The efficiency of someone who understands they're being redirected and accepts it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、先行研究をただ追随するな
lines.en: Ren, don't just follow existing research.
lines.style: Steady instruction. Weight on the caution. Warm underneath the direction — this is investment, not criticism. Slight pause before the negative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会会場の係員もお手伝いします
lines.en: Yes. I'll also help the conference staff.
lines.style: Polite closing note. Small shift in energy — he's offering something extra, almost eager to be useful. Slightly lighter than before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究方向をきめる前に相談しろ
lines.en: Ren, consult with me before you set your research direction.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. The weight of experience in the phrasing. Slower pace. A boundary drawn with care — this is about preventing missteps, not controlling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先行研究とくらべての独自性を示します
lines.en: Yes. I'll demonstrate how my approach differs from prior research.
lines.style: Formal, resolved closing. Each phrase carries intention. Slightly higher register — the tone of someone accepting a challenge and meaning to meet it.
